purpose: Sanitized household, meal-convenience, housing, and recurring-life-admin model derived from the local iCloud mail index. It avoids prices, addresses, account identifiers, and health conclusions.

household_context.planning_scope: Recent evidence supports treating many groceries, home purchases, housing decisions, and discretionary household choices as two-person planning rather than purely individual consumption.
household_context.caution: A household purchase or food order does not prove which person selected, consumed, or preferred it.

housing_and_home_administration.behavioral_signal: The user often asks for the actual process/checklist before a move or policy-sensitive change, but may need help keeping administrative follow-through visible over time.
housing_and_home_administration.current_state_rule: A September 2026 rental application was under review; therefore housing assumptions should remain variable until newer evidence resolves the outcome.
housing_and_home_administration.privacy_rule: Exact addresses and private third-party tenant information remain local and are excluded from the durable profile.

interpretation: Convenience/mobile ordering is an actual recurring behavior, not just a hypothetical meal preference.
Meal planning that assumes every dinner will be cooked from scratch would conflict with observed behavior.
A realistic plan should include inexpensive low-prep meals, planned takeout/convenience slots, and ways to avoid emergency food spending.
meal_convenience_pattern.caution: These are order-confirmation signals, not a complete food diary, and they do not establish who ate each order or any medical/dietary conclusion.

cooking_and_home_project_interest.interpretation: There is real interest in cooking equipment, pantry organization/preservation, and practical DIY, even though recent convenience-food behavior means planning should not assume high-effort cooking every day.

retail_and_grocery_signal_quality.caution: Retailer message volume includes promotions, membership notices, orders, shipping, and recommendations. These counts are not spending totals and are not sufficient to infer where most groceries are purchased.

vehicle_administration.current_vehicle_signal: A 2012 Honda Accord is strongly supported in 2026 correspondence.
vehicle_administration.agent_behavior: Vehicle reminders are a good fit for stateful commitments with due dates and completion evidence.

medium_confidence: iPhone 11 inferred from personally addressed accessory purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 inferred at household level from repeated accessory purchases.
household_technology_signals.rule: Accessory purchases and household orders should stay confidence-labeled rather than silently becoming personal-device facts.

planning_implications_for_agent: Meal planning should optimize for cost, two-person acceptance, low-prep fallback options, and leftover control.
Housing tasks should be tracked as a project with documents, deadlines, next actor, and unresolved questions.
Vehicle maintenance should be converted from email noise into actionable reminders.
Home/cooking purchases should be separated into durable equipment needs versus promotional impulse opportunities.
Do not infer spending totals from email receipts; use the dedicated finance data path when financial analysis is requested.
